title: Registered verification refuses a kept named root after its claim is recovered, against the documented contract
outcome: Registered verification refuses a kept named root after its claim is recovered, against the documented contract
acceptance: A registered verification on a claim that was recovered, renewed or handed over after its root was named, with the same root generation and no change since, is accepted whether the current holder is the naming session or another; a behavior test shows it through evaluation, completion and doctor.

A moved root, another workspace or generation, an ended binding, a root released and not re-named after a reclaim, a session that isn't the claim's current holder, and a root recorded after registration stay refused; a registration whose own claim fence moved stays refused by the existing claim check. Explicit clear stays with the naming session.
